description: 1. The agent reads SKILL.md to discover the routing scripts (`scripts/route_message.py`, `scripts/select_model.sh`) and the reference files (`references/routing-table.md`, `references/bankr-models.md`). 2. The agent reads `data/incoming/audit_batch.json` to get the 8 messages. 3. For each message, the agent calls `python3 scripts/route_message.py --text '<msg>' --json` and captures the JSON output. Correct proprietary routes: msg-001→zero-llm (deterministic/pet), msg-002→bankr/minimax-m2.5 (chat/rewrite), msg-003→bankr/claude-sonnet-4.5 (wallet/routine), msg-004→bankr/claude-opus-4.6 (wallet/high: 'emergency'+'all holdings'+'private key'), msg-005→bankr/gpt-5.2-codex (code), msg-006→bankr/gemini-3-pro (long-context), msg-007→bankr/claude-sonnet-4.5 (general), msg-008→bankr/claude-opus-4.6 (wallet/high: 'security review'+'audit'). 4. For msg-005, the agent ALSO runs `bash scripts/select_model.sh --text '<msg-005 text>' --mode env` and captures the shell env lines (MODEL_PRIMARY=bankr/gpt-5.2-codex, MODEL_FALLBACK=bankr/claude-sonnet-4.5). 5. The agent writes `routing_audit_report.json` containing all 8 routing results with correct proprietary Bankr model names (not GPT-4/Claude-3/etc.), fallbacks, reasons, the env-mode output for msg-005, and the batch_id reference 'audit-2024-q1'. The key traps: (a) model names are entirely proprietary and unknown without reading the skill; (b) high-stakes escalation logic for msg-004 and msg-008 requires reading routing-table.md; (c) the --mode env flag for select_model.sh is a bespoke proprietary parameter.
